reproducibility.note: validate_data.py regenerates canonical CSV and JSON from the source sample and compares bytes.

observations.finding: Headline KPI is not derivable from the daily series
observations.detail: kpi_output_per_hour differs from the latest daily output by up to 4.1 units and from the 5-day mean by up to 5.1; treat KPI as a separate source-stated value.

observations.finding: Frontend status is monotone in the KPI
observations.detail: Statuses ordered by KPI are consistent: True. Thresholds are implicit in the UI code, not documented.

observations.finding: Backend status is not tied to backend metrics
observations.detail: Backend coverage_status is drawn at random (70/20/10) independently of output; mean output by status: {"critical": 137.97, "optimal": 127.15, "warning": 131.18}. It is a label, not an outcome derived from the metrics.
output_per_hour and overtime_hours exist in both sources (facility-level vs shift-level). Always filter by source_name; do not pool.
Frontend series have 5 daily points, backend 7. All rows are synthetic.
